MgADP is an endogenous regulator of the KATP channel and that the KATP channels are the target of the ATP-sensitive potassium (KATp) channel opener, diazoxide.

the KATP channel is a critical component of the insulin secretory pathway and that the KATPP channel is a critical link between the cellular metabolic state and electrical activity.
